headline: Paying the builder in cash?
Check the limit first.
cash_rules.sub: The limit is €1,000 when a business is involved, or €10,000 if you're not tax resident in Spain.
items: The limit counts the whole job, not only the cash part.
The fine is 25% of the cash, and both sides are liable.

headline: What the Nota
Simple won't show.
items: Unpaid community fees aren't on it, because they aren't registered.
Unpaid IBI property tax isn't on it either, so check with the council.
The cadastral and reference values sit with the Catastro.

headline: I live in Norway and own
in Spain. Whose law
decides my estate?
inheritance_foreign_law.sub: Without a choice in your will, it's the law of where you live.
items: You can choose the law of your nationality instead.
Your will has to make that choice expressly.

headline: The national rental number
no longer applies.
items: The Supreme Court annulled it in three rulings in 2026.
Your listing still needs the regional tourist number.

buying_fees.headline: The same resale in Andalucía pays €21,000 in transfer tax.
buying_fees.sub: The tax depends on the region and on whether the home is a resale or a new build.

headline: Buying a flat?
Ask about the fees owed.
community_fees.sub: The flat stays liable for this year's fees due and the three years before.
items: These debts don't appear on the Nota Simple.
The community secretary's certificate shows what is owed.
The secretary has 7 calendar days to issue it.

headline: The notary checks
the deed, not the deal.
items: The notary advises both sides and negotiates for neither.
Your own checks belong before the signing day.
Notary fees follow a fixed government tariff.

headline: Why do two Spanish
accounts cost so
differently?
free_banking_myth.sub: Each provider sets its own fees, and the Banco de España doesn't approve them.
items: Before you sign, the provider must give you its fee document.
Comparing those documents shows the likely yearly cost.

headline: Buying rural land?
Compare three records.
items: Check the Land Registry, the Catastro and what stands on the plot.
In Andalucía, action on most unlicensed works is possible for six years.

property_insurance.headline: The days run from when you learn of the damage.
property_insurance.sub: Notifying late doesn't cancel the claim by itself, but the insurer can claim for the harm the delay caused.

headline: Is your pool
on the deeds?
extension_deeds.sub: Work built after registration may be missing from the Land Registry.
items: Compare the Nota Simple, the Catastro and what is built.
A declaration of new work brings the description up to date.
Each region sets how long the council can act on unlicensed works.

headline: 183 days isn't
the only test.
items: You're resident if you spend more than 183 days in Spain in a year.
You're also resident if your main economic interests are in Spain.
Your registration certificate doesn't decide your tax residency.

headline: Village, town or city.
What should I check
for the address?
village_or_city_spain.sub: Most local services can be checked before you buy.
items: Each town has one water supplier, so ask the seller for the latest bill.
Each council sets its own IBI property tax rate and dates.

headline: Two autumn tax items,
from two authorities.
items: Your council sets the IBI property tax dates on its notice.
The 2025 imputed income return is due by 31 December 2026.

alquiler_opcion_compra.headline: When the owner is a non-resident, that 3% goes to the tax office on Modelo 211 within a month.
alquiler_opcion_compra.sub: The option clauses should say how much of the rent counts toward the price.

headline: It costs money
even when you're away.
holiday_home_running_cost.sub: Most of the fixed costs are set by law or by your council.
items: Imputed income tax is due on a home you don't let.
The whole year's IBI property tax falls on the 1 January owner.
Community fees follow the yearly budget and its reserve fund.

headline: Spain's version
of a leasehold.
items: A surface right lets you own a building on someone else's land.
It can last for a maximum of 99 years.
Check how many years remain before you sign the arras.

headline: I want to let it long
term. How long is
the tenant's lease?
landlord_tenant_issues.sub: The tenant can extend it year by year up to five years.
items: It's seven years when the landlord is a company.
The deposit for a housing let is one month's rent.

headline: From NIE to DNI
after you become Spanish.
items: You take the oath within 180 days of being notified.
Your NIE number stays with you for life.

credit_card_fees.big_label: A switch of provider takes at most
credit_card_fees.headline: That's 13 business days, and moving your account in Spain is free.
credit_card_fees.sub: The new provider moves your direct debits and standing orders for you.

headline: Ask the seller for
four things first.
utilities_setup.sub: They make every supply transfer simpler.
items: Ask for the electricity, gas and water suppliers' names.
Ask for the latest bill and the CUPS code for each supply.
Ask for the electrical installation certificate, if they have it.

headline: I'm switching accounts.
Who moves my
direct debits?
direct_debit_switch.sub: Your new provider does, within 13 business days at most.
items: Keep your own list of bills and tick each one off as it moves.
A biller can't insist your account is in Spain if it's in the EU or EEA.

headline: Same rent, a different
tax on it.
items: An EU resident pays €1,520 on €12,000 of rent with €4,000 of costs.
A UK resident pays €2,880, because the costs can't be deducted.

hidden_bank_fees.big_label: A basic account costs at most
hidden_bank_fees.headline: It is open to anyone legally resident in the EU.
hidden_bank_fees.sub: Compare your yearly fee statement with the fee document you got when you opened the account.

headline: What does your policy
pay if it's occupied?
occupation_cover.sub: It depends on the wording, so ask your insurer in writing.
items: Ask whether occupation is included or an extra.
Ask whether it applies while the home is empty part of the year.
A home held through a company can't use the express court route.

headline: No certificate,
no listing.
items: Every advert for sale or rent must show the energy rating.
Holiday homes that are sold or let now need one too.
Ask for the registered certificate at instruction.

headline: My buyer wants to be
able to walk away.
Which arras is that?
ag_arras_window.sub: Only arras penitenciales give that right, and the contract must say so.
items: Without clear wording, the courts treat arras as confirmatorias.
Penitenciales cost the buyer the deposit, or the seller double.

headline: Your buyer has the keys.
Now the admin starts.
ag_partner_week_after_keys.sub: A short plan by topic saves everyone time.
items: The CUPS code on each bill is the reference for every supply.
The owner on 1 January owes that year's IBI property tax.
Give the administrator an email address for meeting notices.

ag_seller_debt_certificate.headline: That's the three previous years, plus the part of this year already due.
ag_seller_debt_certificate.sub: Ask for the secretary's certificate on every resale, before the arras is signed.

headline: Off-plan payments need
a guarantee first.
items: Each staged payment must be guaranteed by an insurer or a bank.
The money goes into a special account kept apart.

headline: New tourist lets
need a vote.
items: Since 3 April 2025, a new tourist let needs the community's approval.
The vote needs three fifths of the owners and of the quotas.
The community can raise that flat's share of costs by up to 20%.

headline: A building is on the plot
but not on the deeds.
Can it be registered?
ag_rural_land_checks.sub: It can, once the regional enforcement period has run out.
items: In Andalucía that period is six years, and none runs on protected land.
In the Comunitat Valenciana it's 15 years for works after 20 August 2014.

headline: The first year,
written down.
ag_partner_aftersales_list.sub: A written list gives each obligation a date and an owner.
items: Tax on 2026 rent is declared between 1 and 20 April 2027.
The owner on 1 January pays that year's IBI property tax.
Insurers should hear of a loss within seven days.

ag_true_buying_costs.headline: That is the transfer tax, charged by value band in Cataluña.
ag_true_buying_costs.sub: The same transfer tax on a resale is 6% in Madrid and 7% in Andalucía.

headline: Two red flags
worth naming early.
items: The seller isn't the registered owner on the Nota Simple.
A developer asks for staged payments with no guarantee.

headline: Three dates
run from completion.
items: The buyer pays the 3% withheld to the tax office within one month.
The seller files the Modelo 210 tax return in months 2 to 4.
The plusvalía tax is declared within 30 business days.

headline: How long does my
buyer's NIE take?
ag_nie_timing.sub: It commonly takes a few weeks, but no date can be promised.
items: The application is form EX-15, and the fee in Spain is €9.84.
Start it as soon as the decision to buy is made.

headline: A checklist
to go with the keys.
ag_partner_handover_service.sub: Most of the admin after handover sits with the new owner.
items: The holder and the contracted power are changed separately.
Without an ordinary policy, there's no Consorcio cover.
The Modelo 210 tax can be paid from a SEPA account abroad.

ag_rental_registration_2025.big_label: The national rental number ended in
ag_rental_registration_2025.headline: Listings now need the regional tourist number.
ag_rental_registration_2025.sub: The Supreme Court annulled the state registration in three rulings.

headline: Your client's Modelo 210
question, answered.
items: An empty home pays tax on 1.1% or 2% of its cadastral value.
The tax rate is 19% for EU and EEA residents, and 24% for others.

headline: Is a signed arras
already a contract?
at_arras_window.sub: Yes. A private arras contract binds without a notary.
items: Arras are read as confirmatorias unless the clause clearly says otherwise.
The double-repayment rule applies only where it is written in.

headline: Two tax duties
fall on the buyer.
at_nonresident_seller.sub: Both belong in the completion figures.
items: The buyer withholds 3% and pays it on Modelo 211 within a month.
The buyer also pays the plusvalía as substitute taxpayer.
The plusvalía is declared within 30 business days.

headline: The questions
that come later.
items: The CUPS code stays the same when the supplier or holder changes.
Each town has one water supplier, so there's no choosing.
The Modelo 210 tax can be paid by direct debit from abroad.

at_succession_tax.headline: Modelo 650 can get six more months if you ask within the first five.
at_succession_tax.sub: Non-resident heirs can opt for the regional rules, which often give larger reliefs.

headline: On rural land, check
the class of land first.
items: The limitation period depends on the region and the class of land.
On some protected land in Andalucía, no period runs at all.

headline: A parent is gifting
the flat. How long
is there to file?
at_gift_tax.sub: The gift tax return, Modelo 651, is due within 30 business days of the gift.
items: An inheritance allows six months, so the gift deadline is far shorter.
The plusvalía tax on the gift has the same 30 business days.

headline: Do the Spanish
fractions apply?
at_spanish_wills.sub: They apply only where Spanish law governs the estate.
items: By default, the law of the habitual residence at death applies.
A client can choose the law of a nationality they hold.
Under Spanish common law, two thirds go to descendants.

headline: One page for
the first year.
items: The 1 January owner owes the whole year's IBI property tax.
Owners behind on fees can attend meetings but can't vote.
New tourist lets in a community need its express approval.
